column1: # The authored compile census's expectations: one line per committed authored
# case, its id, then its cell on each profile of the header: `compiled`, or the executor's
# stable refusal label. On a C3 venue's profile, a compiled cell is followed by
# ` artifact=SHA256`, the digest of what a run of the case executes there, computed at the
# build the `artifacts_at` line names. Written only by `corpus-triage --audit authored-compile
# --bless` or `--bless-additions`; a merge conflict here is resolved by blessing again at the
# merged tree, never by taking a side.
